title: Jam sessions and the big band at Grunewald
summary: Sonny Stitt sat in once, a Barbarin taught drums, and the school big band played stock arrangements.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: So there wasn't a way that I could go in the day. And the day was better than the night. Even Sonny Stitt came down there one time. He went over there and they had like a jam session over there with different ones. And different ones sat in. That Paul Barbaran, what is his other brother? Had Paul Barbaran his brother?
Isidore. Isidore? I think it's Isidore.

It's one of those Barbarans, he was teaching over there, he was teaching how to play drums over there too. And they had a big band, they played Lemon Drop, you know, it was very popular at the time. They'd bring stock arrangements in and the band would play. Yeah.
Did they bring outsiders in a lot? Was that something?
Not that I know. During the day they said a lot went on there, but I can't.
